title: Smooth algebras are base changes of smooth algebras over finitely generated subrings
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $R\to S$ a smooth ring map [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. Then there are a subring $R_0\subseteq R$ generated (as a ring) by finitely many elements of $R$, so that $R_0$ is of finite type over $\mathbf Z$, a smooth ring map $R_0\to S_0$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], and an isomorphism of $R$-algebras $S\cong R\otimes_{R_0}S_0$ (tensor product formed via the inclusion $R_0\subseteq R$).
